items.title: VIAV's Q1 Beat and Q2 Outlook Highlight Data Center Momentum Ahead

items.title: Keysight Technologies (KEYS) Rolls Out AI And Power Test Products At electronica 2026
items.summary: Keysight Technologies (NYSE: KEYS) used electronica 2026 to unveil new test and measurement products across AI infrastructure, communications, power electronics, and cybersecurity. The firm expanded its high power automated test equipment lineup with added voltage and power options aimed at complex power system workloads. Keysight announced a collaboration with Tower Semiconductor to certify photonic design tools and rolled out the compact XR3 oscilloscope for scalable multi channel test...
